summary: Contribution by Kristian Muri Knausgård. Policy v2 (RH foundation). A reflected certificate for distinct zeros. The explicit formula gives a pointwise multiplicity bound using a Fejér-weighted von Mangoldt sum W of length T^0.999. This is coupled to the Bui–Heath-Brown mollifier B, with P(v) = 1.78v − 0.78v², through reflected mixed moments involving ζ′(ρ)B(ρ)W(1−ρ). Low and high prime ranges are treated separately: the low range is a case of Benli–Elma–Ng, Theorem 1.1 and Corollary 1.2; the high range is new. An auxiliary short prime sum and second-moment control of the remaining range and higher prime powers complete the certificate, which yields N_d ≥ (0.8539 − o(1))N on (T, 2T] and (0, T]. The formal 19/27 simple-zero development and the first packed block come from knausgard-rh-bui-heath-brown-deg40.
